title: RowlessNodeFacet
description: What rowless knows about the node behind a dataset that no standard facet has a slot for: which engine resolved it, where it is defined in the repository, whether rowless could see inside it, and how much lineage was withheld for weak evidence.

kind.description: What the node represents in the rowless graph.

engine.description: Adapter that resolved the schema: polars, duckdb, ibis, pyspark. Null for a source, which no engine was needed to read.

origin.description: Where the relation is defined, as `file:line` when known, else the table URI or model name.

opaque.description: True when rowless could not see inside the node: a failed dry run, an unprobed UDF, a dynamic select. Lineage downstream of an opaque node is incomplete by construction, and the node is published rather than omitted so that the gap is visible instead of looking like a graph that simply ends.

untracedColumns.description: Columns of this dataset published with no column lineage at all.

withheldEdges.description: Column edges rowless resolved but did not publish because the only evidence was a matching column name. Set ROWLESS_OPENLINEAGE_INCLUDE_NAME_MATCH=1 to publish them.
